settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy. If you are not completely satisfied, simply contact us for a full refund or exchange.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Standard delivery takes 5-10 business days depending on your location. Tracking details will be emailed to you.

settings.question: How can I contact customer support?
settings.answer: You can reach our 24/7 support team by emailing support@eduthoo.com. Feel free to contact us anytime!

settings.question: Are these products covered by a warranty?
settings.answer: Yes! All our products come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty.
